title: Hooking up AI to Blender to "fix" my crappy model
author: spacespacespapce

comments.author: spacespacespapce
comments.body:
Testing an "edit" mode for my text-to-blender agent. Idea is that you can upload your blender files and have AI make edits, such as adding better materials, fix lighting, fixing invalid geometry, etc.

Would this be a helpful tool?

replies.author: daddyxsmolone8
replies.body: Absolutely yes, especially if no other such tools exist and are well known! Nice job

replies.author: Aromatic_Dig_5631
replies.body: Could you make this agent rebuild that crap that other 3D generators build?

replies.author: spacespacespapce
replies.body: haha what crap do you mean?

comments.author: MoreLibrarian772
comments.body: Are you developing this tool, or is it a test you did using a specific tool? I don't understand. 😅

replies.author: spacespacespapce
replies.body: I'm working on this "edit" feature for [NativeBlend](https://nativeblend.app) \- an AI Blender model builder

comments.author: CulturalFig1237
comments.body: Oh I believe this is helpful. Especially, for those who are building worlds where they want it to be tokenized.
